sentences.en: In a letter to the editor, a former prisoner wrote that he begged the victim's family for forgiveness.
sentences.ko: 독자 편지에서 한 전과자는 피해자 가족에게 용서를 빈다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Penjual itu meminta ampunan setelah salah mengirim barang ke alamat Intan.
sentences.en: The seller begged for forgiveness after sending the wrong item to Intan's address.
sentences.ko: 그 판매자는 인탄의 주소로 물건을 잘못 보낸 뒤 용서를 빌었어요.

sentences.text: Bayu melihat foto polisi yang memegang tameng saat mengamankan demonstrasi.
sentences.en: Bayu looked at a photo of police holding shields while securing a demonstration.
sentences.ko: 바유는 시위 현장을 지키며 방패를 든 경찰 사진을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Intan memesan pelindung layar sebagai tameng agar ponsel barunya tidak tergores.
sentences.en: Intan ordered a screen protector as a shield so her new phone wouldn't get scratched.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 새 휴대폰이 긁히지 않도록 방패 삼아 화면 보호 필름을 주문했어요.

sentences.text: Kartun di halaman opini itu berisi sindiran halus tentang jalan berlubang.
sentences.en: The cartoon on the opinion page contains subtle satire about potholed roads.
sentences.ko: 의견면 만화에는 구멍 난 도로를 슬쩍 꼬집는 풍자가 담겨 있어요.

sentences.text: Ulasan Intan berisi sindiran tentang foto produk yang terlalu banyak diedit.
sentences.en: Intan's review contained a jab at product photos that were edited too much.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 후기에는 너무 보정한 상품 사진을 꼬집는 말이 들어 있었어요.

sentences.text: Bayu langsung mengenali logat Jawa narasumber yang ia telepon.
sentences.en: Bayu immediately recognized the Javanese accent of the source he phoned.
sentences.ko: 바유는 전화한 취재원의 자와 억양을 바로 알아챘어요.

sentences.text: Kurir yang mengantar paket Intan berbicara dengan logat Sunda yang ramah.
sentences.en: The courier who delivered Intan's package spoke with a friendly Sundanese accent.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 택배를 가져온 기사는 다정한 순다 억양으로 말했어요.

sentences.text: Tajuk rencana edisi Sabtu membahas moralitas para pejabat publik.
sentences.en: The Saturday edition's editorial discusses the morality of public officials.
sentences.ko: 토요일 판 사설은 공직자들의 도덕성을 다뤄요.

sentences.text: Intan sering membaca diskusi tentang moralitas belanja barang tiruan.
sentences.en: Intan often reads discussions about the morality of buying counterfeit goods.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 가품을 사는 것의 도덕성에 관한 토론을 자주 읽어요.

sentences.text: Bayu menulis tentang tempat penitipan anak yang dibuka khusus untuk pedagang pasar.
sentences.en: Bayu wrote about a daycare center opened especially for market traders.
sentences.ko: 바유는 시장 상인들을 위해 문을 연 어린이집에 대해 썼어요.

sentences.text: Intan mengambil paketnya di tempat penitipan barang dekat stasiun.
sentences.en: Intan picked up her package at the parcel storage point near the station.
sentences.ko: 인탄은 역 근처 물품 보관소에서 택배를 찾았어요.
